name: local-service-manager
description: 本地服务管理器 · 跨平台（Windows / macOS / Linux）桌面应用
author: dev

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "node scripts/wait-dev.js && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/launch-electron.js --dev"
scripts.dev:tools: concurrently -k "vite" "node scripts/wait-dev.js && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/launch-electron.js --dev --devtools"
scripts.test: node test/smoke.test.js && node test/template-edit.test.js && node test/template-from-form.test.js && node test/template-cnid.test.js && node test/path-slash.test.js && node test/runner-executor.test.js && node test/status-semantics.test.js && node test/confirm-guard.test.js && node test/poll-visible.test.js
scripts.test:i18n: node test/i18n.test.js && node test/i18n-main.test.js && node test/i18n-plural.test.js
scripts.test:cross: node test/crosscheck-A-blackbox.test.js && node test/crosscheck-B-whitebox.test.js && node test/crosscheck-arbitrate.js out-cross.json
